parts.name: mantle_shell
parts.where: The large central triangular dome forming the creature's upper head, including its pale oval markings and outer outline.

parts.name: side_fins
parts.where: The two broad triangular wing-like flaps projecting behind the mantle on the upper left and upper right.

parts.name: face_frame
parts.where: The pale rounded frame across the lower mantle that completely surrounds the dark visor, including its small rivets.

parts.name: visor
parts.where: The single dark rounded rectangular window centered inside the face frame.

parts.name: eyes
parts.where: The pair of vertical glowing oval eyes set separately inside the left and right halves of the visor.

parts.name: side_pods
parts.where: The two metallic housings attached immediately outside the face frame, one on each side of the head.

parts.name: tentacles
parts.where: All curling appendage masses below and beside the head, including the four large pale-and-pink arms and the smaller darker rear appendages.

parts.name: tentacle_joints
parts.where: The exposed collars, pivots, dark connectors, and mechanical bases separating the tentacles from the head and from their articulated segments.

parts.name: suction_cups
parts.where: All dark-ringed circular openings on the bulbous ends and inner sides of the tentacles.

parts.name: central_nozzle
parts.where: The small glowing cylindrical jet or nozzle hanging at the exact center beneath the face.
